CoreWeave Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results Disciplined Growth at Scale Drives Record Third Quarter Revenue and Expanding Margins LIVINGSTON, N.J., – November 10, 2026 – CoreWeave, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRWV), The Essential Cloud for AI Ⓡ , today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. "This was a breakout quarter for CoreWeave, with revenue increasing by more than $1 billion sequentially and adjusted operating margins reaching double digits a quarter ahead of plan," said Michael Intrator, co-founder, chairman and chief executive officer of CoreWeave. "Our growth is supported by multiple sources of funding, including financing backed by customer contracts, operating cash flow, and approximately $9 billion in customer prepayments and deposits expected in the next three months alone. That financial flexibility positions us to keep delivering the infrastructure and software customers need to build, run, and scale AI." Business Outlook We are raising our full year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $13.0 billion to $13.3 billion. We are also raising our full year 2026 adjusted operating income 2 guidance to a range of $1.275 billion to $1.375 billion, representing a 26% increase at the midpoint compared with our prior guidance. We continue to expect more than 1.85 gigawatts of active power at year-end. We now expect full year 2026 capital expenditures of $37 billion to $39 billion, raising the low end of our prior guidance range of $35 billion to $39 billion. This is as a result of our expectation to deploy infrastructure and deliver it to customers sooner than planned. We expect interest expense for Q4 2
